items.text: Future Career School offers career guidance after 12th for computer science students choosing between a CS seat, an allied branch, and BTech CS versus BCA versus a plain BSc CS, before an admission decision this competitive turns into an expensive assumption.

Computer Science cutoffs are brutal this admission cycle, so most 12th-pass students land in one of three spots: they have the CS seat but are not sure it is actually right for them, the cutoff pushed them into IT, AI & Data Science, or ECE instead, or they are stuck choosing between the three course formats with no real sense of the difference.
